guide_solution: "What kind of stories did Aesop tell?" asked Abdullah. "Fables," replied Mr. Rahman. "Do you know what fables are?" "No," replied Abdullah. "Well," continued Mr. Rahman, "Fables are stories with a message or a moral." Part−B : Composition See the Composition Part of Special Preparation Supplement + Model Book ৯০ −
